title: RIROS: A Parallel RTL Fault SImulation FRamework with TwO-Dimensional Parallelism and Unified Schedule
problem: RTL fault simulation for safety-critical applications is time-consuming due to imbalanced task loads from dynamic fault propagation paths, slowing verification cycles.
method: Two-dimensional parallel framework combining structural-level and fault-level parallelism with work-stealing and unified computation/synchronization scheduling to minimize execution bubbles.
key_novelty: First two-dimensional parallelism approach for RTL fault simulation balancing heterogeneous task loads.
contributions: Work-stealing mechanism for handling numerous low-load tasks
Unified scheduling approach eliminating synchronization bubbles
primary_theme: Parallel RTL fault simulation for safety-critical chips
